introduction: This specification defines `GiteaPlatform`, a concrete implementation of `PlatformProtocol` in the `afissues` package, targeting the Gitea REST API v1. Note: requirements referencing `afissues._http` and `afissues._ssrf` APIs are based on interfaces defined by the upstream GitLab spec (spec 04) and should be cross-checked against those modules before implementation.

glossary.ConfigError: An exception class from afissues.errors raised when a configuration value (such as a URL) is invalid or disallowed.
glossary.GitHubPlatform: The concrete PlatformProtocol implementation for GitHub, defined in afissues/github.py.
glossary.GitLabPlatform: The concrete PlatformProtocol implementation for GitLab, defined in afissues/gitlab.py; GiteaPlatform follows the same HTTP integration pattern.
glossary.GiteaPlatform: The concrete PlatformProtocol implementation for Gitea-hosted repositories, defined in afissues/gitea.py.
glossary.IntegrationError: An exception class from afissues.errors raised when an external API call fails in an unexpected way.
glossary.IssueComment: A data class defined in afissues.protocol representing a comment on an issue, with fields: id, body, user, created_at.
glossary.IssueResult: A data class defined in afissues.protocol representing a Gitea/GitHub/GitLab issue, with fields: number, title, html_url, body, labels.
glossary.PlatformProtocol: The abstract interface in afissues.protocol that all platform implementations must satisfy, defining the 12 standard methods for issue and PR management.
glossary.SSRF: Server-Side Request Forgery — a class of attack where an attacker causes a server to make requests to unintended internal or external addresses.
glossary._resolve_label_id: An internal async method on GiteaPlatform that resolves a label name to its numeric Gitea label ID, using an in-memory cache.
glossary._validate_url: A function in afissues._ssrf with signature `_validate_url(url: str) -> None` that raises ConfigError if the URL is disallowed (SSRF guard).
glossary.afissues: The Python package housing the platform abstraction layer, containing GitHubPlatform, GitLabPlatform, GiteaPlatform, and shared utilities.
glossary.afissues._http: A shared module in the afissues package providing HTTP retry logic, extracted by the GitLab spec; GiteaPlatform uses the same integration pattern as GitLabPlatform.
glossary.afissues._ssrf: A shared module in the afissues package providing SSRF guard utilities, extracted by the GitLab spec.
glossary.base: In pull request context, the target/destination branch name.
glossary.forge_type: A class-level string attribute on platform implementations identifying the forge type (e.g., 'gitea', 'github', 'gitlab').
glossary.head: In pull request context, the source branch name to be merged.
glossary.label ID cache: An in-memory dict[str, int] on GiteaPlatform instances that maps label names to their numeric Gitea IDs to avoid repeated API calls.
glossary.parse_gitea_remote: The aliased name used when the platform factory imports parse_remote from afissues.gitea.
glossary.parse_remote: A module-level function in afissues/gitea.py that parses a Gitea remote URL and returns (owner, repo) or None.
glossary.platform_factory: The module at agentfox/nightshift/platform_factory.py that constructs the appropriate PlatformProtocol implementation based on the configured platform type.
glossary.type=issues: A Gitea API query parameter filter that excludes pull requests from issue list results, since Gitea treats PRs as a subtype of issues.
glossary._validate_url(url): SSRF guard function from afissues._ssrf that validates a URL and raises ConfigError for restricted addresses.
glossary.create_label: Protocol method to create a repository label idempotently.
glossary.dict[str, int]: Python type annotation for the label name-to-ID cache mapping.
glossary.from afissues.gitea import GiteaPlatform: Import statement used by platform_factory to load the Gitea platform class and remote URL parser.
glossary.https://{url}/api/v1: Gitea REST API base URL template.
glossary.{'Authorization': f'token {token}'}: Gitea authentication header dictionary using token-based auth.
glossary.'gitea': String literal identifying the Gitea forge type in platform configuration and the forge_type class attribute.

correctness_properties.title: Label ID cache consistency
correctness_properties.for_any: sequence of _resolve_label_id and create_label calls within a single GiteaPlatform session
correctness_properties.invariant: the `label ID cache` never contains stale entries introduced by this instance; a name→ID pair is added only when fetched from the API (full fetch) or when create_label successfully creates a label (single-entry insert); no entry is removed mid-session

correctness_properties.title: Numeric label IDs used exclusively for assignment and removal
correctness_properties.for_any: call to assign_label, remove_label, or create_issue with a non-empty labels list
correctness_properties.invariant: `_resolve_label_id` is called for every label name before any HTTP request that requires a label ID; no label name string is ever sent as a label identifier in POST or DELETE requests to Gitea label endpoints

correctness_properties.title: Error response text truncated to 500 characters
correctness_properties.for_any: IntegrationError raised due to a non-success HTTP response
correctness_properties.invariant: the error message includes at most 500 characters of response text; no IntegrationError message embeds more than 500 characters of raw API response

correctness_properties.title: type=issues always present on list endpoints
correctness_properties.invariant: the query parameter `type=issues` is always included in the GET request, ensuring pull requests are never returned in issue list results

correctness_properties.title: PlatformProtocol default parameters mirrored exactly
correctness_properties.invariant: default parameter values match `PlatformProtocol` exactly: list_issues_by_label defaults state='open', sort='created', direction='asc'; close_issue defaults comment=None; create_label defaults description=''

correctness_properties.title: ConfigError never re-wrapped by GiteaPlatform
correctness_properties.invariant: `ConfigError` raised by `_validate_url` propagates unchanged to the caller; GiteaPlatform never catches or re-wraps it as `IntegrationError` or any other exception type

correctness_properties.title: close_issue makes no comment HTTP call when comment is None
correctness_properties.invariant: exactly one HTTP request is made (the PATCH state=closed); no POST to the comments endpoint occurs
